LanguageData.BredinCaptivity.ReductionLabel: Wildness reduction per generation: {0} percentage points
LanguageData.BredinCaptivity.ReductionDesc: Each animal born to two colony-tamed parents of the same species is this many percentage points less wild than its more domesticated parent, down to 0%. A change applies to future offspring only; animals that already exist keep their current Wildness.
LanguageData.BredinCaptivity.PenFreeLabel: Domesticated animals don't need pens (restart required)
LanguageData.BredinCaptivity.PenFreeTooltip:
Colony animals with 10% Wildness or less are treated as area-controlled instead of pen-managed: they can be given allowed areas and are no longer taken to pens.
Requires restarting the game to take effect.
